primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in liver fat by MRI-PDFF at Week 6.
efficacy_outcome: Liver fat percent change was −54.07%, −58.14%, −60.28%, and −47.75% across the four combination regimens, versus −3.58% with placebo; reported p-values were <0.0001 for three regimens and 0.0003 for the fourth.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths were reported in any group (placebo 0/15; combination groups 0/15, 0/13, 0/18, and 0/14).
